title: Ramsays bolt a plaque to the mesa

tellings.quote: So, in 2007, Suzanne and Scott fixed the record themselves by bolting a plaque to the mesa, signed and dated.

plain: In 2007 a couple named Scott Ramsey and Suzanne Ramsey bolted a signed and dated plaque onto a mesa in Hart Canyon, near Aztec, New Mexico, the place where a craft is said to have crashed with sixteen alien bodies aboard. Michels tells it himself, saying the couple did it to "fix the record" on what happened there, since no official marker said so.
